policy.model_isolation: Only native identity.person_name maps to PERSON; compare all models under identical PERSON-only gateway merge.
policy.address_proxy: contact.address maps to LOCATION only in gateway_address_proxy; ADDRESS is not generic geographic LOCATION.
policy.native_masking: Union of every native span from each decoder against all original gold types; no unsupported types removed.
policy.merge_confidence: Fixed 0.85 compatibility weight, matching spaCy NER; not a calibrated model probability or fitted threshold.
policy.decoding: One model forward extraction per text, then the official hybrid decoder over the same raw spans.
policy.selection: No schema or threshold fitting on any of the three corpora.
policy.overlong_gateway_candidates: If any candidate exceeds the existing 200-character contract, the affected gateway profile is unavailable on that corpus; native scores retain it.

model.decoder: Official model_spans once, followed by unchanged hybrid_spans.

organizer.scope: Synchronized predict_both calls on this corpus only; includes both decoders, excludes cache serialization; not HTTP RPS.

pii.scope: Synchronized predict_both calls on this corpus only; includes both decoders, excludes cache serialization; not HTTP RPS.

redmadrobot.scope: Synchronized predict_both calls on this corpus only; includes both decoders, excludes cache serialization; not HTTP RPS.

timing.scope: Sequential model extraction plus both official decoders, no HTTP/masking/Redis; not service RPS.
Sequential local NER calls only; not HTTP throughput or service RPS.

organizer.purpose: Frozen model outputs for reproducible offline rules/merge regression; never gold labels; not HTTP/latency measurement

timing.scope: Sequential local NER calls only; not HTTP throughput or service RPS.

labels.person: Proper names of individual people: given names, surnames, patronymics or initials. Exclude generic roles, job titles, kinship terms, pronouns and numeric identifiers.
labels.location: Geographic proper names of cities, settlements, regions and countries. Exclude organizations, institution names, generic facility types and field labels.
labels.organization: Names or references to companies, banks, government agencies and other institutions.

performance.scope: Sequential warm local model calls only, no HTTP, Redis, masking or concurrency; not service RPS.

organizer.purpose: Frozen predictions for a separate model comparison; never annotations; local inference only.

native_full_masking_all_types.scope: All native labels and all original gold labels; union of alphanumeric character positions.

full_masking_all_gold_types.gold_scope: All original gold categories, including unsupported categories.
full_masking_all_gold_types.prediction_scope: Actual service masks; every model/rule type retained; alphanumeric characters only.

gateway_profiles.scope_notice: Subset scores are secondary; all-type/unfiltered and full masking retain unsupported gold and predictions.

native_full_masking_all_types.scope: All native labels and all original gold labels; union of alphanumeric character positions.

full_masking_all_gold_types.gold_scope: All original gold categories, including unsupported categories.
full_masking_all_gold_types.prediction_scope: Actual service masks; every model/rule type retained; alphanumeric characters only.

gateway_profiles.scope_notice: Subset scores are secondary; all-type/unfiltered and full masking retain unsupported gold and predictions.

native_full_masking_all_types.scope: All native labels and all original gold labels; union of alphanumeric character positions.

limitations: Organizer silver labels are provisional AI annotations, not official organizer ground truth.
All corpora were previously inspected for system development; this is a fixed-model transfer experiment, not an untouched pipeline holdout.
GLiNER schema/threshold selection used organizer data previously; LFM receives no tuning in this experiment.
PERSON-only is a shared-label comparison; native all-type masking has a different task scope and is reported separately.
Native contact.address is not generic LOCATION; its gateway mapping is an explicit proxy ablation.
LFM native decoders provide no calibrated confidence; 0.85 is a fixed merge compatibility weight only.
No unsupported original gold or native model category is discarded from full native masking or unfiltered gateway scopes.
Typed character diagnostics count all span characters; full masking counts alphanumeric characters as the service does.
Corpus metrics are not the organizer's private score. Local sequential timing is not HTTP RPS.
